subject: Re: Tuesday appointment
text:
Hi,

Thanks for checking on the appointment. I still plan to keep the Tuesday session, but I have a conflicting commitment that started the same week. My advisor moved a deadline review to the afternoon, so I will need to leave early or switch slots. If we can move to Thursday, that would give us the full meeting without cutting it short. I can review the notes before then and send my section ahead. Please let me know what your schedule looks like once you have checked it and update the reminder before the session.
